contract.purpose: Connect Reasonix prompt, tool, compaction, and stop events to SNARC memory capture and injection.
contract.scope: Adapt UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse, compaction, and Stop events into SNARC capture, search, briefing, and consolidation calls.

invariants.invariant-1: SNARC failures never block the Reasonix loop unless explicitly configured.
invariants.invariant-2: Compaction capture must happen before valuable conversation turns are lost.
